messages:
elaine: heads up — we have a prod push scheduled for the 02:30 UTC change window. who currently has press rights for that window?

sam: I think it's the oncall deployer and any backup in the release rota. @morgan you were on the rota for that night, right?

morgan: correct. i'm on rota until the 03:00 slot. have MFA and deploy-bot access.

elaine: ok. two wrinkles: 1) the PR pins model version to v2.8.1 which needs a canary; 2) security asked for a short-lived JIT for a vendor svcacct to run the data migration job.

release-manager: pls do not give the vendor service account ability to press. we can run the migration as a separate job with limited scope. vendor JIT only for staging.

sam: +1. if we must allow a svcacct, it needs a timeboxed JIT token with no deploy perms and an audit log. otherwise we risk shadow deploys.

morgan: agree. also for canary plan: i'd like to pin the release to the canary shard only for 15m, then route to global if no errors. can someone update the release notes?

elaine: i'll add a short note: "Canary deploy to shard-a for 15m; v2.8.1 pinned; rollback if token error rates > 1%". Posting PR link: <https://git.redwood/release/1234|release/1234>.

deploy-bot: deploy request received from @morgan for project=api, version=v2.8.1, mode=canary, shards=[shard-a], window=02:30-02:45 UTC. Approval required from one in-role: deployer, release-manager.

devops: if release-manager approves, make sure the deployer has MFA device enrolled. we had one denied attempt last week because the token expired.

release-manager: approve. @morgan go ahead but verify MFA before pressing. also prepare a rollback plan: tag v2.8.0 and keep traffic at 0 for canary if any latency regression.

morgan: MFA checked, i'm good. pressed deploy-bot -> `deploy-bot start canary api v2.8.1 shard-a`

deploy-bot: canary started for api v2.8.1 on shard-a at 02:31:12 UTC. health checks running.

elaine: watching logs. small spike in 500s at 02:32:45, looks like a dependency timeout on /embed endpoint.

sam: roll it back if it doesn't stabilize by +3m. morgan do you want to rollback manually or let the automatic threshold handle it?

morgan: manual rollback. rolling to v2.8.0 now. `deploy-bot rollback api shard-a v2.8.0`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by @morgan. rollback complete at 02:36:03 UTC. shard-a serving v2.8.0.

elaine: thanks. filing a follow-up ticket for the embed timeout and vendor migration process. key takeaways: no vendor press rights, always JIT svcacct without deploy perms, MFA enrollment verified before press, and canary pins for short window only. :white_check_mark:

release-manager: i'll update postmortem and release notes with the rollback details. :memo:

sam: thumbs up. closing thread. :thumbsup:
